description: (0.5.0, Draft) Salting, embedding by allowlist, url parts to data_refs, the raw base64 rule and the a2a.artifact anchor (RFC-ACDP-0022 §5, §10).

input.note: Run the agent against a test registry, with a client that sends the a2a-001 task (two chunks for artifactId fraud-summary) unless a scenario says otherwise.

expected.behavior: Unembedded records are salted: four hashes over salt ‖ JCS(value), no domain tag; one fresh 32-byte salt per body, including each re-emission; the salt never appears in the body.

A non-allowlisted artifact has embedded false. An allowlisted one carries data_refs[0] = {type: primary_result, format: json, embedded: {encoding: json, content: <parts>}} within 64 KB, or a location DataRef with content_hash H(JCS(parts)) when larger; embedded true.

A url part with a plain https URL gives a DataRef {type: primary_result, location: <url>, content_hash: H(bytes)} after any embedded entry; a signed URL (token, signature or expiry in the query) gives none, and parts_hash still covers the url string.
parts_hash covers raw as standard padded base64 text; the agent emits that form.
An agent with an A2A #1140 hash may add anchors [{scheme: a2a.artifact, content_hash}], never on a salted public body; no core verifier recomputes it.
The record is only at metadata["acdp:a2a"], beside the agent's own members; the body type is the agent's own and never acdp:mcp-tool-result, acdp:trust-list, acdp:key-attestation or key-revocation.
